popCulture.title: Triptolemus
popCulture.description: Demeter's Eleusinian envoy — the youth in the winged chariot who carries grain and the Mysteries' gift of agriculture.

popCulture.title: Homeric Hymn to Demeter
popCulture.description: The hymn names Triptolemus among Demeter's Eleusinian hosts — the mortal who receives the goddess's teaching.
